# Philadelphia Metropolitan Area

[All metro areas](../data-sources.md)

**Covers:** Philadelphia and its suburbs, Berks County, PA, South Jersey, northern Delaware and Cecil County, MD. The title bar shows which of these parts a place is in: Philadelphia, Berks County, PA, South Jersey, Delaware or Cecil County, MD.

**Counties:** Philadelphia County, PA; Bucks County, PA; Chester County, PA; Delaware County, PA; Montgomery County, PA; Berks County, PA; Burlington County, NJ; Camden County, NJ; Gloucester County, NJ; Salem County, NJ; Cumberland County, NJ; Atlantic County, NJ; Cape May County, NJ; New Castle County, DE; Kent County, DE; Cecil County, MD. Within the service area, the app tells which metro area and which of its parts a place is in by its county, or, on the water or a pier, by the nearest county. [Why these counties](../metro-areas.md#philadelphia-metropolitan-area)

## Operators

| Operator | Runs | Real-time | Key needed |
|---|---|---|---|
| SEPTA | Regional Rail trains, Metro (subway and trolley lines) and buses | Yes | No |
| NJ Transit | Rail, the River LINE and buses | Rail and buses, with your own account | Optional NJ Transit developer account ([sign up](https://developer.njtransit.com/registration)) |
| Amtrak | Trains in the area | No | No |
| Trans-Bridge Lines (through NJ Transit's website) | Coaches from Quakertown, Doylestown and New Hope to Port Authority Bus Terminal | No | No |
| Academy Bus (through NJ Transit's website) | Coaches from Willingboro and Westampton to Manhattan | No | No |
| Delaware River Port Authority (PATCO, through National RTAP) | PATCO trains | No | No |
| PHLASH (Philadelphia Visitors Center Corporation) | Seasonal visitor bus loops in Center City and West Fairmount Park | No | No |
| Pottstown Area Rapid Transit | Buses in and around Pottstown | Yes | No |
| Greater Valley Forge TMA (Upper Merion Rambler, through National RTAP) | Buses in Upper Merion Township and King of Prussia | No | No |
| Transportation Management Association of Chester County (TMACC ChescoBus, through Modeshift) | Buses in Chester County | No | No |
| BARTA (Berks Area Regional Transportation Authority) | Buses in Reading and Berks County | Yes | No |
| Cecil Transit (through Passio) | Buses in Cecil County, MD, and to Newark, DE | Yes | No |
| Cross County Connection (BurLINK, through NJ Transit's website) | Buses in Burlington County | No | No |
| Gloucester County (through NJ Transit's website) | A shuttle in Logan Township | No | No |
| Atlantic County (through NJ Transit's website) | Community shuttles in Atlantic County | No | No |
| Cumberland County Division of Employment and Training (through NJ Transit's website) | Shuttles in Bridgeton and Vineland | No | No |
| South Jersey Transportation Authority (SJTA, through NJ Transit's website) | Shuttles in Pureland, Pennsauken and Vineland | No | No |
| Maryland Transit Administration (MARC) | MARC trains; only its Perryville station, in Cecil County, MD, is in the area | Yes | No |
| Delaware River and Bay Authority | Cape May–Lewes Ferry; only its Cape May terminal is in the area | No | No |

## Keys and accounts

Most real-time feeds here are free and need no key. For the ones below, you request a key or account yourself. Each is free, each person uses their own, and the app keeps it only in the macOS Keychain. Without it, that operator's times come from its timetable and are marked "Timetable", except where noted below.

- **NJ Transit developer account** (NJ Transit rail and bus real-time data): sign up on the [NJ Transit developer site](https://developer.njtransit.com/registration) and select the GTFS-RAIL and GTFS-BUS APIs. NJ Transit reviews each request and emails you when the account is approved. Enter the same username and password in **Settings → Data source → Keys and accounts**, with the username written exactly as the developer site shows it at the top right and the approval email writes it, including capital letters.
